Alex: heads-up — noticed ~3x p95 increase on hosted inference around 03:12 UTC after driver roll to 535.61. p50 unchanged. Traces point to a sudden jump in kernel-level latency, not queuing. Anyone else seeing this? @Meera
Meera: saw the perf alert. Repro'd locally on a dedicated pool with a small-batch chat workload (seq<=64, batch 8). Triton selector logs look different — it picked a matmul split kernel instead of the flash-attn path.
Jonathan: which kernel names exactly? paste the triton selector snippet please.
Alex: here's the selector + nvprof sample I grabbed from an affected host:
```
triton-selector: chosen_kernel=matmul_split_k_128x256  alt=flash_attn_fwd
model=chat-small  seq_len=48  batch=8
kernel_time_ms=0.98 -> 3.12
nvprof summary:
CUDA Kernel: matmul_split_k_128x256  avg 2.9ms  occupancy 42%  calls=480
previous baseline (flash_attn_fwd): avg 0.9ms
```
Lina: that's odd — we used to consistently pick flash_attn_fwd for these shapes. Driver/optimizer heuristics might have changed occupancy/regalloc estimates. Could explain the selector scoring flip.
Samir: dug into an Nsight trace: the matmul kernel now shows heavy register spilling compared to before. Counters from the same model run (old driver -> new driver):
```
registers_per_thread: 40 -> 56
spill_stores: 120k -> 410k
local_mem_bandwidth_spill: increased
l1_hit_rate: 0.78 -> 0.44
```
ops-bot: deploy:driver/535.61 rolled to us-west-2 at 2026-03-15T03:05:00Z
Meera: temporary mitigation — we can force the selector to prefer flash_attn_fwd for seq<=64 or add an explicit kernel override for affected model variants. Can someone patch and test in staging?
Jonathan: testing kernel override in staging now. Added `kernel_override: flash_attn_fwd` in model routing config for chat-small. Running a 1h soak with same traffic pattern. Initial results: p95 back down to ~0.95ms.
Alex: good signal. Need to determine root cause: is this a driver-side compiler/regalloc change that increases register pressure for our split-k matmul? Or did Triton's kernel scoring heuristics change because of different occupancy estimation?
Lina: action items: 1) open vendor bug with Nsight trace & perf counters (Samir), 2) add selector feature-flag to prefer flash-attn for short sequences (Meera/Jonathan), 3) add a regression test in GPU perf CI that runs on the new driver image (eng-sre).
Samir: filed BUG-3921 with Nvidia + attached Nsight tarball and sample reproducer. Link: https://internal.redwood/bugs/3921
Meera: opened PR for the override + rollout plan: https://github.com/redwood/serving/pull/1234. Will gate on staging soak (1h) and perf CI before canary.
Jonathan: note — also saw KV cache coalescing behavior changed in the batcher (we merged small kv updates into larger fused requests) which bumped effective seq_len for some requests. That makes selector pick matmul path more often; combined with driver regression it's amplified. We should add a unit that measures selector decisions under fused-kv profiles.
Alex: agreed. If staging soak stays green, schedule a canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC with a fast rollback plan. Post mortem once we have vendor response. :thumbsup:
